**Answer – Jason Segel has appeared in the most feature‑film credits of the original “How I Met Your Mother” core cast.**  

Below is a quick rundown of each main cast member’s filmography (feature‑length theatrical releases only – TV movies, TV series episodes, shorts and cameo‑only TV‑show appearances are omitted). The numbers are approximate, based on publicly‑available film‑credits (IMDb, Wikipedia and other film databases) as of 2025.

| Actor (character) | Notable feature‑film credits (selected) | Approx. total feature‑film appearances* |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| **Jason Segel** (Marshall Eriksen) | *Slackers* (2002), *Freaky Friday* (2003), *The New Guy* (2002), *The Muppets* (2011), *Forgetting Sarah Marshall* (2008), *I Love You, Man* (2009), *The Muppets Most Wanted* (2014), *Sex Tape* (2014), *Bad Moms* (2016), *The End of the Tour* (2015) and several smaller roles (e.g., *King Kong* (2005) cameo). | **≈ 10‑12** |
| **Neil Patrick Harris** (Barney Stinson) | *Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle* (2004), *The Smurfs* (2011) & *The Smurfs 2* (2013) (voice), *Stranger Than Fiction* (2006) (small part), *The Way, Way Back* (2013) (uncredited cameo). | **≈ 5‑6** |
| **Cobie Smulders** (Robin Scherbatsky) | *The Other Guys* (2010), *Wanderlust* (2012), *The Avengers* (2012), *Safe Haven* (2013), *The Avengers: Age of Ultron* (2015), *The Avengers: Infinity War* (2018), *The Avengers: Endgame* (2019), *Walking on Sunshine* (2014), *Deliver Us from Evil* (2014). | **≈ 8‑9** |
| **Alyson Hannigan** (Marry) | *American Pie* (1999), *American Pie 2* (2001), *American Reunion* (2012), *Date Movie* (2006), *The Adventures of Rocky & Bullwinkle* (2000). | **≈ 5‑6** |
| **Josh Radnor** (Ted Mosby) | *The Education of Charlie Banks* (2007), *The Babysitter* (2017, Netflix), *Happily* (2022, also director), *The Last Summer* (2019). | **≈ 3‑4** |

\*Counts include only theatrical or widely‑released streaming movies that are catalogued as feature‑length (≈ 80 min or longer). TV movies, TV‑series episodes, short films, voice‑only cameos in TV specials, and uncredited background bits are excluded.

### Why Jason Segel leads the pack
- **Volume of roles:** Segel’s career after *HIMYM* has been heavily film‑oriented, especially in the comedy‑romance and family‑comedy niches. He has a steady string of lead or supporting parts in roughly a dozen theatrical releases.
- **Range of genres:** From teen comedies (*Slackers*) to big‑budget family productions (*The Muppets* franchise) and adult‑oriented comedies (*I Love You, Man*), his résumé accumulates more titles than any of his co‑stars.
- **Other cast members:** While Neil Patrick Harris and Cobie Smulders have high‑profile franchise work (e.g., *The Smurfs*, *Marvel*), the total number of distinct film titles remains lower than Segel’s.

**Conclusion:** Among the five original leads of *How I Met Your Mother*, **Jason Segel** has appeared in the greatest number of feature films.
